name: Dumbbell Overhead Press

instructions.description: Stand or sit holding dumbbells near shoulder height.
Brace the trunk gently and keep wrists stacked.
Press the dumbbells overhead through a comfortable path.
Lower them slowly to shoulder height.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the external load used without treating it as a universal target.

variations.variationDescription: Dumbbell Overhead Press — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Dumbbell Overhead Press — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Use a range that is comfortable for the shoulders.
